symptom: `mxcli exec` of `create java action Probe.JA_Hello () returns String as $$ return "hi"; $$;` printed only "Created java action: Probe.JA_Hello" while also writing javasource/probe/actions/JA_Hello.java; `git status` then showed the .java (and a JavaScript action's .js under javascriptsource/) untracked, so a workflow that commits the model (.mpr + mprcontents/) left the body behind and a clone got an action with no logic
cause: Nothing reported writes beside the model. The backend already knew each one — `WriteSourceIfChanged` returns whether the content changed and `noteFileWrite` counted it, but only as a number feeding the Unchanged decision; the path never left the backend, and each handler printed its model-element sentence on its own
file: `mdl/backend/source_files.go` (SourceFileChange, SourceFileReporter); `mdl/backend/modelsdk/backend.go` (noteSourceFile, TakeSourceFileChanges), `java_write.go`, `javascript_write.go`, `module_write.go` (removeModuleSourceDirs); `mdl/executor/source_file_report.go`, drained in `executor_dispatch.go` executeInner, summary in `flushTally`
insight: Record the change where the bytes move, not in the handler: only the writer knows the path and whether the content actually differed, so a handler-side `Wrote …` would print for an identical rewrite (the reports-that-outrun-the-write shape). One drain after every statement in executeInner then covers every writer — create/modify, rename (Moved a to b), drop (Removed), DROP MODULE's folder removal — with no per-handler print to forget. Writers found by grepping os.WriteFile/Rename/Remove/RemoveAll under mdl/ and sdk/: java_write.go, javascript_write.go, module_write.go; widget_defs.go also writes during exec (.mxcli/widgets/*.def.json, and widget docs on refresh catalog), deliberately not reported — gitignored, regenerable caches that `mxcli git commit` unstages anyway. `exec` has no JSON mode, so the reporter's third suggestion does not apply. Control: with the drain disabled, an 11.13.0 app shows the issue exactly (model elements only, both source files untracked). Not fixed here, measured on 11.13.0: `move java action MvA.JA_Mv to MvB` leaves the body at javasource/mva/actions/JA_Mv.java and `describe` of MvB.JA_Mv says the Java source is not available; and exec's rollback restores only .mpr/mprcontents, so a failed run's 'Nothing was written' is untrue of these files
